question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. INCESSANT
solution:
The correct answer is: **Continuous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Incessant"** refers to something that continues without pause or interruption. (लगातार, बिना रुके)
 
 
• **Example:** The incessant noise of traffic made it hard to concentrate.
 

 
• **"Continuous"** means ongoing or unbroken, often used to describe something that happens without stopping. (अविरत, निरंतर)
 
 
• **Example:** The rain has been continuous since morning, causing floods in low-lying areas.
 

 
• Since "incessant" and "continuous" are synonymous, the correct answer is "Continuous."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Continuous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Frequent** (बार-बार): Occurring often or repeatedly.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a frequent visitor to our house on weekends.
 
 

 
• **Recurring** (पुनरावर्ती): Happening repeatedly or periodically.
 
 
• **Example:** Her recurring headaches made her consult a doctor.
 
 

 
• **Repetitive** (दोहराया हुआ): Involving repetition, often to the point of monotony.
 
 
• **Example:** The repetitive nature of his job made him lose interest over time.
 
 

39:Te7d,
The correct answer is Option 3</
